config._comment: Bobby, 2026-11-12: halving-cycle time bonus (mNAV x) added to each stock's cheap cap AND overvalued / overheated floor (zone labels, cards, per-stock chart cheap_gate / ov_line, and the call's overheated filter). Shape per stock: 0 until ramp_days before next_halving_est; quadratic ramp ((t+ramp)/ramp)^ramp_shape up to the halving; full amp for hold_days; linear fade to 0 over fade_days (~the usual BTC cycle top, ~535 days after a halving); then bear_bonus (0, never negative). Amplitude = amp_next[ticker] for the next halving, x decay_per_cycle for each later one (cycle_days apart, ~4 years). Earlier halvings are not back-cast. Also drives the call (Bobby 2026-11-12): {key}_oh_floor_call = the same floor (incl. the preferred-par slide); the call's overheated filter still requires mNAV >= the floor AND >= mnav.overheated_percentile. Re-check next_halving_est against mempool.space every quarter (block 1,050,000; 12 Nov 2026 estimate 4-15 Apr 2028). Rules-based, not financial advice.

thresholds._comment: All signal thresholds live here. Edit and push; the daily workflow (or a manual run) recomputes signals.json and the dashboard.
thresholds._assets_comment: Companies tracked. The page, recommendation, analytics and backtest loop over this list. Adding a third company also needs a holdings/share-count + capital adapter in scripts/update_data.py and scripts/capital.py (BTC held, shares, debt, preferred, cash). The rotation spread uses the first two.

recommendation._comment: Single call per day. Flywheel ON for the call = code RUNNING_HOT or ON (the preferred CLOSED >= peg.on_close_threshold and has not since spent > peg.off_minutes_below market minutes below peg.on_trade_threshold; WARMING_UP is off). MSTR is also not on while buyback_support is flagged. Parent all-in mNAV overheated (per-stock floor incl. halving bonus + preferred slide AND overheated_percentile, on overheat_basis) is a filter; if both flywheels are on and neither overheated, an unusual rotation z picks the cheaper one, a normal z gives BUY_BOTH. Otherwise STAY_BTC (displayed as WAIT).

peg._comment: Flywheel rule (review applied 2026-10-28). Turns ON only on a completed daily CLOSE >= on_close_threshold for that preferred (STRC $100.00, SATA $99.80); an intraday touch never turns it on, and before the 4 PM ET close the call uses the last completed close. Once ON it stays ON until it trades below on_trade_threshold for MORE THAN off_minutes_below consecutive regular-session minutes (overnight/weekend gaps don't count). Labels: RUNNING_HOT (on, price >= running_hot.price_min AND heavy volume) > ON ('FLYWHEEL ON') > WARMING_UP (OFF for the call / watch only: traded >= on_trade_threshold without a qualifying close; STRC closes $99.80-$99.99 too) > COOLING_OFF (off, price >= stalled_below) > STALLED (off, below stalled_below). Older history with daily bars only: ON at a qualifying close; OFF at a close < on_trade_threshold; a day whose high touched on_trade_threshold but closed below the close threshold is WARMING_UP (off). full_on_threshold is now display-only (share of closes at/above it). See scripts/flywheel.py.

on_close_threshold._comment: Daily CLOSE needed to turn the flywheel ON, per preferred (review change 1).

running_hot._comment: Heavy volume at/above par: on AND latest price >= price_min AND volume >= vol_mult_min x the prior vol_avg_days trading-day average (today: pace = volume so far / fraction of the session elapsed) AND, when intraday bars exist, >= min_share_at_or_above of the day's volume traded at >= price_min.

atm._comment: Bobby's rule (2026-11-04): a day where the issuer actively sold the preferred through its ATM (data/atm_activity.json, shares_sold > 0) with intraday high >= min_high and close >= min_close counts like a qualifying close: promotes to at least FLYWHEEL ON. That ON then persists under the usual off rules (more than off_minutes_below minutes below on_trade_threshold, or a daily-approx close below it); a later day with no ATM row that closes slightly under $100 does not drop it to WARMING_UP. STRC ATM sales also turn the buyback flag OFF and keep it off until a later 8-K week (ending after that ATM date) shows buybacks with no sales. Price-close rule remains the fallback when no ATM data exists. 8-K check (2026-11-15): @STRC_live rows are provisional; see verify_8k.

verify_8k._comment: Fix 2026-11-15 (Bobby): @STRC_live ATM rows are provisional until the issuer's weekly 8-K for that date is filed. Verified periods = automatic (Strategy weekly 8-K STRC ATM/repurchase tables for STRC; Strive weekly 8-K SATA share count for SATA) + manual entries in `file` (manual wins). A row with shares_sold > 0 inside a period whose verdict is 'no_sales' is cancelled: it no longer counts as an ATM day for FLYWHEEL ON and no longer clears the buyback flag. Applied to the whole recomputed history. Routines: when a new Strategy/Strive weekly 8-K contradicts or confirms an @STRC_live row and the parser missed it, append {preferred, issuer, start, end, filed, verdict: 'no_sales'|'sales', sec_shares_sold, source_url, note} to verified_periods in the file and push; never edit the raw @STRC_live row. Published in signals.json -> atm_verification. Rules-based, not financial advice.

mnav._overheated_comment: Overheated floor is per stock per date: valuation.halving_bonus.base_cap (1.10x) + that stock's halving bonus + overheated_gap_above_cheap, plus mnav.anticipation (preferred-driven sliding premium: proximity to par + 5-day tilt) while the flywheel is OFF, or max(the ON / RUNNING_HOT bonus, anticipation.max_premium) while ON / RUNNING_HOT so the line never drops below the off-state maximum. There is no extra RUNNING_HOT bump on top of max_premium. Overheated (the call's filter, {key}_oh_floor_call, same floor since 2026-11-12) = mNAV >= floor AND >= overheated_percentile of the lookback. The OVERVALUED zone is floor OR that percentile. overheated_min_mnav is the legacy fixed floor, kept only as a fallback. overheated_bonus_on / overheated_bonus_running_hot remain the legacy ON / RUNNING_HOT adders (0.15 / 0.30); with anticipation.enabled they are floored at max_premium (both 0.30 under the 2026-11-11 rule).

anticipation._comment: Bobby, 2026-11-11: sliding 'anticipation' premium on the overheated floor and a matching CHEAP-gate bump, driven by how close the parent's preferred is to par (STRC for MSTR, SATA for ASST) and whether it is climbing or falling. Symmetric; no fixed ASST extra. Off-state floor premium = clamp(max_premium x proximity + tilt, 0, max_premium), with proximity = clamp((preferred close - low) / (on_trade_threshold - low), 0, 1). Tilt is +/-tilt from the preferred's trend_days trading-day close change; |change| < tilt_dead_zone is flat (tilt 0). Missing preferred close -> premium 0. When the flywheel is ON or RUNNING_HOT, floor premium = max(overheated_bonus_on or overheated_bonus_running_hot, max_premium) and score = 1. The same 0-1 score (off premium / max_premium) raises the CHEAP gate: cheap_cap_eff = cheap_cap + cheap_cap_bump x score, cheap_pct = valuation.cheap_max_percentile + cheap_percentile_relax x score (25th -> 40th at full score). CHEAP is display-only and does not change the call. Regular-session closes only. Buyback rule (2026-11-15): while buyback_support flags the preferred (par held by the issuer's own buybacks, no ATM sales), premium = 0 and score = 0 (zero_while_buyback_held), so buyback-held par never raises the cheap cap, the cheap percentile or the overvalued / call floor; the halving bonus and base gap are unchanged. The slide applies normally whenever the flag is off.

mnav._both_overheated_comment: when MSTR and ASST are both overheated, the legacy per-asset action is sell / trim both and no buy right now (overrides flywheel-driven parent actions); the main call shows WAIT
mnav._signal_basis_comment: Which mNAV drives overheated / rotation / dip / zones: 'ev' (all-in: equity at basic shares + debt + preferred notional - cash, over BTC NAV), 'basic' (market-standard: price x basic shares / BTC NAV) or 'diluted' (price x assumed-diluted shares / BTC NAV).
mnav._ev_share_basis_comment: Share count used for the equity leg of EV. 'basic' (Strategy's own EV definition) avoids double-counting convertible notes, which are already in debt. 'diluted' is an option.

valuation._comment: Zones, applied to each mNAV basis separately using each stock's own trailing mnav.lookback_trading_days (252) percentile on that basis: OVERVALUED: mNAV >= the stock's overheated floor OR percentile >= mnav.overheated_percentile (90th). CHEAP: percentile <= the per-day cheap_pct (valuation.cheap_max_percentile, 25th, plus mnav.anticipation.cheap_percentile_relax x score, up to the 40th when the preferred is at/near par or the flywheel is ON) AND mNAV <= the stock's cheap_cap_eff (halving_bonus.base_cap + that stock's halving bonus + cheap_cap_bump x the same score). FAIR: percentile <= rich_above_percentile (75th) (incl. bottom-quartile days above the cap). RICH: above the 75th percentile, below OVERVALUED. See mnav.anticipation for the score (preferred proximity + 5-day tilt). Hysteresis (2026-11-15): zone_buffer_mnav (0.03x) - a zone label changes only once mNAV is at least 0.03x beyond the line it crossed (zone re-tested at mNAV -/+ 0.03 with the percentile recomputed); otherwise the previous day's label is kept. Applies to all zone labels / charts for MSTR and ASST on both bases; the call's overheated filter is NOT buffered. Raw (unbuffered) labels are kept as {key}_zone*_raw in data rows.

halving_bonus._comment: Bobby, 2026-11-12: halving-cycle time bonus (mNAV x) added to each stock's cheap cap AND overvalued / overheated floor (zone labels, cards, per-stock chart cheap_gate / ov_line, and the call's overheated filter). Replaced the old linear cheap_below_mnav_schedule and the MSTR hold_until_median (removed 2026-11-12). cheap cap = base_cap + bonus (+ anticipation cap bump); overvalued floor = cap + mnav.overheated_gap_above_cheap + anticipation premium. Shape per stock: 0 until ramp_days before next_halving_est; quadratic ramp ((t+ramp)/ramp)^ramp_shape up to the halving; full amp for hold_days; linear fade to 0 over fade_days (~the usual BTC cycle top, ~535 days after a halving); then bear_bonus (0, never negative). Amplitude = amp_next[ticker] for the next halving, x decay_per_cycle for each later one (cycle_days apart, ~4 years). Earlier halvings are not back-cast. Also drives the call (Bobby 2026-11-12): {key}_oh_floor_call = the same floor (incl. the preferred-par slide); the call's overheated filter still requires mNAV >= the floor AND >= mnav.overheated_percentile. Re-check next_halving_est against mempool.space every quarter (block 1,050,000; 12 Nov 2026 estimate 4-15 Apr 2028). Rules-based, not financial advice.
halving_bonus._amp_comment: ASST gets the bigger premium (Bobby: smaller, faster horse; easier to stack BTC when its flywheel is on).

dip._comment: Dip = BTC down >= btc_drop_pct over the last lookback_days trading days. Target = whichever of MSTR/ASST had the larger % drop in mNAV (mnav.signal_basis) over the same window (got cheaper vs its own bitcoin); tie (within tie_tolerance) broken by the larger price drop.

big_moves._comment: absolute daily close-to-close % move that counts as a Big Move

capital._comment: Inputs for the all-in (EV) mNAV. Debt, preferred and cash timelines are built automatically from SEC filings + Strategy's KPI API (scripts/capital.py, data/capital_events.json); nothing here is a hand-typed balance.

odds_jumps._comment: Odds Jumps module: flag tracked prediction markets whose Yes probability moved >= jump_24h_pts in one day or >= jump_7d_pts over 7 days, within the last window_days.

buy_flags._comment: Display flags (do not change the recommendation). flywheel_cheap: the parent's flywheel ON (its preferred, an indicator not a trade, code ON or RUNNING_HOT, not held by buybacks) AND parent all-in mNAV zone CHEAP, or FAIR with 1y percentile < low_fair_max_percentile ('low-FAIR'). very_low_mnav (secondary cue for the parent): all-in mNAV <= very_low_max_mnav OR 1y percentile <= very_low_max_percentile, shown even when the parent's flywheel is only cooling off near par.

buyback_support._comment: Par held up by buybacks (review change 3). From the latest Strategy weekly 8-K table: if the latest reported week shows STRC buybacks > 0 and STRC ATM sales = 0 the flag turns on; it stays on until a later 8-K shows STRC sales again. A STRC ATM day in data/atm_activity.json (shares_sold > 0) dated after that week's end clears the flag and keeps it off until a newer 8-K week ending after the ATM date shows buybacks with no sales. While on, MSTR's flywheel does NOT count as on for the call (STRC may still show ON). If the 8-K parse fails, the last known value is kept (data/strc_buyback_state.json) with its date. Only 8-K-verified (or still provisional) ATM rows clear the flag; rows cancelled by an 8-K (peg.atm.verify_8k) do not.

sats_context._comment: SATS context chip near SATA (review change 5). Display only, never a trigger.

thresholds._refresh_trigger_comment: Optional URL of a proxy (see workers/refresh-trigger) that starts update.yml. Empty = Refresh opens the GitHub Run workflow page and polls. Never put a token here.
